site.title: Study Gateway
site.description: Learn DevOps, AIOps, and data and observability engineering through systems, trusted datasets, operational evidence, diagnosis, and recovery.

paths.label: DEVOPS
paths.title: DevOps
paths.description: Build and operate systems, from Linux, networking, AWS, and Kubernetes to backend contracts, data, security, traffic, and reliability.

paths.label: AIOPS
paths.title: AIOps
paths.description: Connect AI models, retrieval, and agents with GPU and MLOps platforms, evidence-based diagnosis, and controlled automated recovery.

paths.label: DATA & OBSERVABILITY
paths.title: Data & Observability
paths.description: Follow events into trusted data and AI: Parquet, lakehouse tables, Spark, Kafka, quality, OpenTelemetry, lineage, governance, and managed platforms.

topics.label: Kubernetes
topics.title: Kubernetes
topics.description: Starting with running a single container, you will learn the process of automatically deploying, replacing, and connecting multiple applications and operating them safely.

documents.title: Complete learning roadmap
documents.summary: Start with containers, images, clusters, Nodes, and Pods, then map out the learning sequence.

translation.title: 쿠버네티스 전체 학습 로드맵
translation.summary: 컨테이너·이미지·클러스터·Node·Pod의 쉬운 뜻부터 전체 학습 순서를 잡습니다.

documents.title: 01. Why Kubernetes and the first cluster
documents.summary: Create a small local cluster, deploy a web server, introduce a failure, and recover.

translation.title: 01. 왜 Kubernetes인가와 첫 클러스터
translation.summary: 내 컴퓨터에 작은 클러스터를 만들고 웹 서버를 배포한 뒤 일부러 고장 내고 복구합니다.

documents.title: 02. API and objects
documents.summary: Follow a YAML declaration into the API and learn how Namespaces scope names, queries, and policies.

translation.title: 02. API와 오브젝트
translation.summary: YAML의 목표가 API에 저장되는 과정과 Namespace로 이름·조회·정책 범위를 나누는 방법을 배웁니다.

documents.title: 03. Cluster architecture and control loops
documents.summary: Trace the components responsible for storing, scheduling, and executing a deployment request.

translation.title: 03. 클러스터 아키텍처와 제어 루프
translation.summary: 배포 요청을 받은 뒤 어떤 구성 요소가 저장·배치·실행을 담당하는지 따라갑니다.

documents.title: 04. Pods and workloads
documents.summary: Choose controllers for long-running apps, stateful workloads, tasks on every Node, and one-time jobs.

translation.title: 04. Pod와 워크로드
translation.summary: 계속 실행할 앱, 데이터를 가진 앱, 모든 Node의 작업과 일회성 작업을 구분합니다.

documents.title: 05. Services and networking
documents.summary: Learn the process of reliably sending requests to Pods whose addresses change and connecting external users.

translation.title: 05. Service와 네트워킹
translation.summary: 주소가 바뀌는 Pod에 안정적으로 요청을 보내고 외부 사용자를 연결하는 과정을 배웁니다.

documents.title: 06. Storage and application configuration
documents.summary: Separate persistent data from ordinary configuration and secrets as containers are replaced.

translation.title: 06. 스토리지와 애플리케이션 구성
translation.summary: container가 교체돼도 남아야 할 데이터와 일반 설정·비밀 설정의 수명을 나눕니다.

documents.title: 07. Scheduling, resources, and autoscaling
documents.summary: Declare CPU and memory needs, understand Pod placement, and learn when workloads scale.

translation.title: 07. 스케줄링과 리소스·오토스케일링
translation.summary: Pod가 필요한 CPU·메모리를 선언하고 어느 Node에 배치되며 언제 늘어나는지 배웁니다.

documents.title: 08. Security and policy
documents.summary: Check the permissions of people and programs, Pod execution limits, and communication allowances with small policies.

translation.title: 08. 보안과 정책
translation.summary: 사람과 프로그램의 권한, Pod 실행 제한과 통신 허용 범위를 작은 정책으로 확인합니다.

documents.title: 09. Observability and troubleshooting
documents.summary: Narrow down the cause of failure by sequentially reading the status, event, and log of Pods that are not running.

translation.title: 09. 관측과 트러블슈팅
translation.summary: 실행되지 않는 Pod의 상태·사건·로그를 순서대로 읽어 실패 원인을 좁힙니다.

documents.title: 10. Production operations and extensions
documents.summary: Review upgrades, backups, and extensions safely and verify behavior against the API reference.

translation.title: 10. 프로덕션 운영과 확장
translation.summary: 업그레이드·백업·확장 기능을 안전하게 검토하고 공식 API 문서를 확인하는 방법을 배웁니다.

topics.label: Linux
topics.title: Linux system operations
topics.description: Diagnosing Linux failures begins with how a single web server runs and uses CPU, memory, disk, and network.

documents.title: Linux system operation roadmap
documents.summary: Learn what programs, processes, services, and ports are and make your first Linux diagnosis.

translation.title: Linux 시스템 운영 로드맵
translation.summary: 프로그램·프로세스·서비스·포트가 무엇인지 익히고 첫 Linux 진단 순서를 잡습니다.

documents.title: Connect services to processes and resources
documents.summary: From the service name, you can find the actual process, open files/ports, and resources in use.

translation.title: Process와 resource의 연결
translation.summary: 서비스 이름에서 실제 프로세스와 열린 파일·포트, 사용 중인 자원을 찾아갑니다.

documents.title: Web server port conflict diagnosis lab
documents.summary: Create a port conflict on a small web server and compare status, log, and connection information to find the cause.

translation.title: Service 장애 진단 실습
translation.summary: 작은 웹 서버에 포트 충돌을 만들고 상태·로그·연결 정보를 비교해 원인을 찾습니다.

topics.label: Networking
topics.title: Network and request path
topics.description: It checks the name search, connection, encryption, and HTTP steps in order until the address entered in the browser is responded to by the server.

documents.title: Network Learning Roadmap
documents.summary: Starting with the host name, IP address, and port, divide ‘I can’t connect’ into small problems.

translation.title: 네트워크와 요청 경로 로드맵
translation.summary: 호스트 이름·IP 주소·포트부터 시작해 ‘접속이 안 된다’를 작은 문제로 나눕니다.

documents.title: How a web request arrives at the server
documents.summary: It follows the DNS result through a TCP connection, TLS confirmation, and HTTP response in one request.

translation.title: DNS부터 backend까지
translation.summary: DNS 결과가 TCP 연결과 TLS 확인, HTTP 응답으로 이어지는 과정을 한 요청으로 따라갑니다.

documents.title: Request diagnosis lab by layer
documents.summary: Compare the normal address with the address that intentionally fails to find out at which stage it stopped.

translation.title: 계층별 장애 분리 실습
translation.summary: 정상 주소와 일부러 실패하는 주소를 비교해 어느 단계에서 멈췄는지 찾습니다.

topics.label: AWS
topics.title: AWS infrastructure foundations
topics.description: Starting with what AWS accounts, permissions, regions, and virtual networks are, you'll learn who owns resources and what access boundaries are.

documents.title: AWS infrastructure foundations roadmap
documents.summary: Learn the simple meaning of account, region, IAM, and VPC and the order of safely exploring AWS.

translation.title: AWS 인프라 기반 로드맵
translation.summary: 계정·리전·IAM·VPC의 쉬운 뜻과 AWS를 안전하게 살펴보는 순서를 익힙니다.

documents.title: Permissions and network paths in AWS requests
documents.summary: Learn why both operation permissions and network paths are required for an AWS request to succeed.

translation.title: Account, identity와 network boundary
translation.summary: 한 AWS 요청이 성공하려면 작업 권한과 네트워크 경로가 모두 필요한 이유를 배웁니다.

documents.title: Verify AWS account and path without changes
documents.summary: Without changing resources, it queries the currently logged in identity and VPC path and reads the results.

translation.title: Read-only AWS 진단 실습
translation.summary: 자원을 바꾸지 않고 현재 로그인한 신원과 VPC 경로를 조회해 결과를 읽습니다.

topics.label: Terraform
topics.title: Terraform on AWS
topics.description: Learn the process of writing down AWS resources you created with a click as code, reviewing the change schedule, and safely reflecting it.

documents.title: Terraform on AWS Roadmap
documents.summary: We start with how Terraform code, state records, and actual AWS resources connect to each other.

translation.title: Terraform on AWS 로드맵
translation.summary: Terraform 코드, 상태 기록과 실제 AWS 자원이 서로 어떻게 연결되는지부터 시작합니다.

documents.title: Code, state, and actual resources
documents.summary: Learn why ordering occurs between resources and how multiple people can safely handle the same state.

translation.title: Resource graph와 state
translation.summary: 자원 사이의 순서가 생기는 이유와 여러 사람이 같은 상태를 안전하게 다루는 방법을 배웁니다.

documents.title: Inspect plans and drift: a guided lab
documents.summary: Run checks and plan commands and read for unexpected changes without creating AWS resources.

translation.title: Plan, drift와 import 실습
translation.summary: AWS 자원을 만들지 않고 검사와 계획 명령을 실행하고 예상하지 못한 변경을 읽습니다.

topics.label: Helm & GitOps
topics.title: Helm Charts and GitOps
topics.description: Learn the process of creating repeated Kubernetes YAML into charts and values, and matching the status written in Git with the actual deployment.

documents.title: Helm and GitOps roadmap
documents.summary: Learn what charts, values, final YAML, and releases are, and divide the roles of Helm and GitOps.

translation.title: Helm Charts와 GitOps 로드맵
translation.summary: 차트·값·최종 YAML·릴리스가 무엇인지 익히고 Helm과 GitOps의 역할을 나눕니다.

documents.title: From chart values to deployed state
documents.summary: The values ​​are fed into the template, made into the final YAML, and compared against the cluster state.

translation.title: Chart, release와 desired state
translation.summary: 값이 템플릿에 들어가 최종 YAML이 되고 클러스터 상태와 비교되는 과정을 따라갑니다.

documents.title: Validate, install, upgrade, and roll back a chart
documents.summary: After inspecting and installing the chart, see for yourself how to change values ​​and revert to a previous version.

translation.title: Render, upgrade와 drift 실습
translation.summary: 차트를 검사하고 설치한 뒤 값을 바꾸고 이전 버전으로 되돌리는 과정을 직접 확인합니다.

topics.label: Observability & SRE
topics.title: Observability and SRE
topics.description: Divide ‘slow service’ into numbers, event records, and request paths and connect the results received by users with goals.

documents.title: Observability and SRE Roadmap
documents.summary: We start with what questions each indicator, log, tracking, service goal, and notification answer.

translation.title: Observability와 SRE 로드맵
translation.summary: 지표·로그·추적·서비스 목표·알림이 각각 어떤 질문에 답하는지부터 시작합니다.

documents.title: From failed requests to service goals
documents.summary: Tie the history of a single request to the overall success rate and learn when to notify people.

translation.title: Signal, SLO와 incident model
translation.summary: 요청 한 건의 기록을 전체 성공률과 연결하고 언제 사람에게 알려야 하는지 배웁니다.

documents.title: Connect failures through metrics, logs, and traces
documents.summary: Find the same request in indicators, logs, and traces and arrange it in chronological order from failure occurrence to recovery.

translation.title: Signal 상관관계와 SLO alert 실습
translation.summary: 같은 요청을 지표·로그·추적에서 찾아 장애 발생부터 회복까지 시간순으로 맞춥니다.

topics.label: PostgreSQL
topics.title: PostgreSQL Operations
topics.description: Starting with what's visible and what's left when multiple requests change data simultaneously, you'll learn about locking, backup, and recovery.

documents.title: PostgreSQL Operations Roadmap
documents.summary: We begin database operation with the simple meaning of transactions, rows, locks, indexes, and backups.

translation.title: PostgreSQL 운영 로드맵
translation.summary: 트랜잭션·행·잠금·인덱스·백업의 쉬운 뜻부터 데이터베이스 운영을 시작합니다.

documents.title: How data changes become visible and durable
documents.summary: It follows the process by which changed data becomes visible to other requests and can be recovered after a failure.

translation.title: MVCC, WAL과 query plan
translation.summary: 변경한 데이터가 다른 요청에 보이고 장애 뒤 복구될 수 있게 되는 과정을 따라갑니다.

documents.title: Diagnose lock waits and restore a backup
documents.summary: After finding out what caused the two changes to conflict on purpose and causing the wait, restore the backup to a separate DB.

translation.title: Lock, backup과 restore 실습
translation.summary: 일부러 두 변경을 충돌시키고 기다리게 한 원인을 찾은 뒤 백업을 별도 DB에 복원합니다.

topics.label: Redis & DynamoDB
topics.title: Redis and DynamoDB
topics.description: Distinguish between quick data to be kept for a while and data to be kept for a long time, and select a storage structure based on the queries you will mainly use.

documents.title: Redis and DynamoDB Roadmap
documents.summary: Learn the simple meaning of key, value, expiration time, and partition and the different situations that require Redis and DynamoDB.

translation.title: Redis와 DynamoDB 로드맵
translation.summary: 키·값·만료 시간·파티션의 쉬운 뜻과 Redis·DynamoDB가 필요한 서로 다른 상황을 익힙니다.

documents.title: Different storage models
documents.summary: Compare Redis cache and DynamoDB order lookups to distinguish the consequences when data disappears.

translation.title: Redis와 DynamoDB의 서로 다른 모델
translation.summary: Redis cache와 DynamoDB 주문 조회를 비교해 데이터가 사라졌을 때의 결과를 구분합니다.

documents.title: Expiration and hot-key lab
documents.summary: Check whether Redis data actually expires and design a situation where DynamoDB requests are concentrated on one key.

translation.title: TTL, eviction과 hot key 실습
translation.summary: Redis 데이터가 실제로 만료되는지 보고 DynamoDB 요청이 한 key에 몰리는 상황을 설계합니다.

topics.label: Security
topics.title: Infrastructure security
topics.description: We securely manage confidential information and deployment files, starting with who requested it and what they can do.

documents.title: Infrastructure Security Roadmap
documents.summary: Learn the simple meaning of identity, authentication, authorization, policy, and confidential information and the security confirmation sequence.

translation.title: 인프라 보안 로드맵
translation.summary: 신원·인증·인가·정책·비밀 정보의 쉬운 뜻과 보안 확인 순서를 익힙니다.

documents.title: Identity, secrets, and artifact lifecycles
documents.summary: You will learn about determining permissions, replacing secret information, and checking the source of deployment files.

translation.title: Identity, secret과 artifact trust model
translation.summary: 권한 결정, 비밀 정보 교체와 배포 파일의 출처 확인을 각각 나누어 배웁니다.

documents.title: Check what actions to allow and what to deny
documents.summary: Pairwise checks are made to ensure that the reads to be allowed succeed and the writes to be prohibited fail.

translation.title: Allow·deny와 artifact 수명주기 실습
translation.summary: 허용할 읽기는 성공하고 금지할 쓰기는 실패하는지 한 쌍으로 확인합니다.

topics.label: Messaging
topics.title: Messaging and event infrastructure
topics.description: Learn what makes it better to store messages between services and how to deal with duplication, reordering, and repeat failures.

documents.title: Messaging and Events Roadmap
documents.summary: We start messaging with the simple meaning of message, producer, consumer, queue, and completion response.

translation.title: 메시징과 이벤트 인프라 로드맵
translation.summary: 메시지·생산자·소비자·큐·완료 응답의 쉬운 뜻부터 메시징을 시작합니다.

documents.title: From delivering messages to completing tasks
documents.summary: It follows step by step why the message is delivered and the work done is different.

translation.title: Delivery, ordering과 replay model
translation.summary: 메시지가 전달된 것과 업무 처리가 끝난 것이 왜 다른지 단계별로 따라갑니다.

documents.title: Duplicate and repeated failure message processing lab
documents.summary: Processing the same message twice only changes the result once and reprocesses failed messages.

translation.title: Duplicate, DLQ와 replay 실습
translation.summary: 같은 메시지를 두 번 처리해도 결과가 한 번만 바뀌게 만들고 실패 메시지를 다시 처리합니다.

topics.label: Reliability & FinOps
topics.title: Reliability·DR·FinOps
topics.description: It determines how successful the service must be and when and how much data must be recovered after a failure, along with the cost.

documents.title: Reliability·DR·FinOps roadmap
documents.summary: Recovery and cost judgments begin with the simple meaning of availability, failure, RTO, RPO, and capacity.

translation.title: 신뢰성·DR·FinOps 로드맵
translation.summary: 가용성·장애·RTO·RPO·용량의 쉬운 뜻부터 복구와 비용 판단을 시작합니다.

documents.title: Connecting recovery goals, processing capacity, and costs
documents.summary: Define a specific failure and associate recovery time, remaining processing power, and associated costs.

translation.title: Reliability, capacity와 cost model
translation.summary: 구체적인 장애를 정하고 복구 시간, 남은 처리 능력과 그에 필요한 비용을 연결합니다.

documents.title: DevOps integration capstone
documents.summary: By connecting the previously learned technology to one small service, we leave evidence from failure occurrence to recovery.

translation.title: DevOps 통합 capstone
translation.summary: 앞서 배운 기술을 작은 서비스 하나에 연결해 장애 발생부터 복구까지 증거를 남깁니다.

topics.label: Advanced · Karpenter
topics.title: Advanced Karpenter
topics.description: You will learn how to create AWS servers for Pods that are waiting because there are no servers to run, and how to safely downsize them when they are no longer needed.

documents.title: Karpenter Advanced Roadmap
documents.summary: We begin the Karpenter in-depth course with the meaning of Pending Pod·Node·Scheduler·NodePool.

translation.title: Karpenter 심화 로드맵
translation.summary: Pending Pod·Node·스케줄러·NodePool의 뜻부터 Karpenter 심화 과정을 시작합니다.

documents.title: How nodes are provisioned and removed
documents.summary: We divide the role of each Karpenter resource from requesting a Pod to creating and replacing a Node.

translation.title: Provisioning과 disruption model
translation.summary: Pod 요구에서 Node 하나가 만들어지고 교체되기까지 각 Karpenter 자원의 역할을 나눕니다.

documents.title: Pending Pods and safe node consolidation
documents.summary: Observe how nodes are created to run pods and when node removal is stopped due to service protection rules.

translation.title: Pending Pod와 consolidation 실습
translation.summary: Pod를 실행할 Node가 생기는 과정과 서비스 보호 규칙 때문에 Node 제거가 멈추는 상황을 관찰합니다.

topics.label: Traffic & Resilience
topics.title: Traffic control and service resilience
topics.description: Ownership of gateway and route is divided, and timeout·retry budget·circuit breaker·outlier detection prevents one failure from becoming a total failure.

documents.title: Traffic Control and Service Resiliency Roadmap
documents.summary: Starting with request path ownership and load limiting, we learn to design so that retries do not cause failures.

translation.title: 트래픽 제어와 서비스 복원력 로드맵
translation.summary: 요청 경로의 소유권과 부하 제한부터 시작해 재시도가 장애를 키우지 않는 설계를 배웁니다.

documents.title: Failure budget from gateway to upstream
documents.summary: Within the overall deadline, the connection, attempt, and retry budgets are divided, and the responsibilities of circuit breakers and outlier detection are separated.

translation.title: Gateway에서 upstream까지의 실패 예산
translation.summary: 전체 deadline 안에서 연결·시도·재시도 예산을 나누고 circuit breaker와 outlier detection의 책임을 구분합니다.

documents.title: Route ownership and retry storm review lab
documents.summary: Read the Gateway API and Envoy settings to check allowed routes, maximum concurrent retries, and recovery decision evidence.

translation.title: Route 소유권과 retry storm 검토 실습
translation.summary: Gateway API와 Envoy 설정을 읽어 허용된 route, 최대 동시 재시도와 복구 판정 증거를 점검합니다.

topics.label: Backend Engineering
topics.title: Backend engineering for production
topics.description: A single HTTP request flows through domain rules and transactions to storage, events, and cache, and learns the entire path that remains as a verifiable result even under overload and change.

documents.title: Backend engineering for production roadmap
documents.summary: Reorganize the vault's backend knowledge axis into an open learning path that connects requests, data, distributed failures, performance, and changes to existing DevOps topics.

translation.title: 운영 가능한 백엔드 엔지니어링 로드맵
translation.summary: vault의 백엔드 지식 축을 공개 학습 경로로 재구성해 요청·데이터·분산 실패·성능·변경을 기존 DevOps 주제와 연결합니다.

documents.title: Request semantics and API contract
